briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion and xAI Grok-4 push multi-agent frontiers amid escalating safety gaps

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies with frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models while regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous agents. Compute scaling continues at hyperscale but vulnerability surfaces remain exposed. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys Orion with native multi-agent orchestration; xAI ships Grok-4 achieving 92% on SWE-bench; DeepSeek-V3 and Meta's Llama-4 follow closely. Google DeepMind advances Gemini 3 with real-time video reasoning. Anthropic's Claude 4 focuses on constitutional AI hardening.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New red-team reports highlight persistent injection risks across agent frameworks. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1.2M units shipped; Microsoft and Google announce $40B combined data center expansions in Texas and Arizona. TSMC 2nm AI chips enter volume production.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level defenses like dynamic dialect negotiation outpace agentic capability growth by 2028?
